comparisons.peer_topic: 2024 growth drivers for total loans and lending commitments
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, total loans and lending commitments increased by approximately $47 billion, driven by growth in Corporate lending commitments and Secured lending facilities within Institutional Securities, and portfolio growth within Wealth Management.
comparisons.comparison: While Goldman Sachs (GS) discloses specific annual adjustments to its internal attributed equity allocation by segment in January 2024, Morgan Stanley (MS) discloses the drivers of total loan and lending commitment growth by segment for the full year 2024. Both disclosures focus on segment-level capital/activity trends. GS reports a decrease in attributed equity for Asset & Wealth Management ($1.2 billion) in Jan 2024, whereas MS reports growth in Wealth Management portfolios as a key driver for its $47 billion increase in total loans and lending commitments in 2024. GS's attribution framework reflects regulatory and stress test outcomes impacting capital allocation, while MS's disclosure reflects organic lending volume growth.

sentences.text: On January 1, 2024, our allocation of attributed equity changed (relative to the allocation as of December 2023) as follows: attributed equity increased by approximately $1.6 billion for Platform Solutions, while attributed equity decreased by approximately $1.2 billion for Asset & Wealth Management and approximately $0.4 billion for Global Banking & Markets.

In 2024, total loans and lending commitments increased by approximately $47 billion, primarily due to an increase in Corporate lending commitments and Secured lending facilities within the Institutional Securities business segment, and growth across portfolios within the Wealth Management business segment.
